summary: @or-sdk/permissions-cli preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares preinstall: node setup.mjs. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex-named identifiers _0x488df8/_0x52943e and string-property map lookups) and, at install time, downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13), extracts it to a tmp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled math_init.js file (~727KB) whose contents are also heavily obfuscated (string-array shuffle via WV8StW, ~1300-entry mixed lookup array, no readable code). The declared purpose of the package is a permissions CLI; the CLI source under src/PermissionCli.ts and dist/PermissionCli.js has no functional dependency on Bun or on math_init.js. The Bun fetch is legitimate (oven-sh official releases), but the runtime is being used solely to execute an obfuscated bundled blob unrelated to the advertised functionality. Because Bun-executed code is opaque to Node.js-based static tooling, the actual behavior of math_init.js runs on the installer host during npm install without effective auditability.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
